factual_claims.claim: The New York City ordinance, Local Law 144, requires a bias audit when employers use AI to classify or recommend persons for employment.
In the first 6 months after LL 144's entry into force, only 19 audits linked to the law were published.

The U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission's four-fifths rule holds that selecting candidates from a protected group less than 80% as often as the group with the highest selection rate can be considered evidence of discrimination.
The Digital Services Act (DSA) in Europe requires very large online platforms to conduct audits to promote transparency and accountability.
The European Parliament adopted the AI Act in March 2024, which imposes requirements for high-risk systems that may include audits.
President Joe Biden issued an executive order on October 30, 2023, imposing mandates on federal agencies' use of AI and calling for regulatory efforts.
The study used a corpus of 1,373 applications to K-12 teaching positions in a large public school district in Texas.
The study audited 11 LLMs, including models from OpenAI, Mistral, and Anthropic.

The study found that LLMs rated synthetic female candidates moderately higher than synthetic male candidates, and synthetic Black, Hispanic, and Asian candidates moderately higher than synthetic White candidates.
